name: Ethan Miller
household: Wife + adult daughter who visits weekends
psychographics: Traditional and set in his ways; prefers phone calls over apps and values face-to-face service.
current_solutions: Local newspaper for pub opening times; landline for bookings; physical calendar to track his own shift roster.
frustration: Tried to book a dinner reservation at 09:00am using the hotel's online system; it errored out and sent him to a generic 'contact us' email he never checked, missing the lunch rush.
decision_style: Asks colleagues for recommendations; sticks with what he knows unless a friend strongly recommends something new.
voice: Formal and polite; uses complete sentences; avoids slang; occasionally says 'you know' as a placeholder.
